title: GetResponse Review 2026: All-in-One Email Marketing That Does It All?
content:
*Affiliate disclosure: Some links in this article are affiliate links. We may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. This never affects our ratings or recommendations. [Full disclosure](/disclosure)*

## Quick Answer

**GetResponse** is a mature, all-in-one email marketing and marketing automation platform trusted by over 350,000 businesses worldwide. Founded in 1998, it has evolved from a simple email autoresponder into a full-featured marketing suite that includes AI-powered email creation, visual marketing automation, landing pages, webinars, sales funnels, SMS marketing, and even a built-in website builder.

With plans starting at **€13.12/mo** (1,000 contacts, billed annually) and a generous free 14-day trial that requires no credit card, GetResponse offers exceptional value for solopreneurs, ecommerce stores, and growing businesses. Its standout features include a 99% deliverability rate, unlimited email sends on all plans, a powerful AI email generator that creates campaigns 85% faster, and a visual automation builder that rivals dedicated platforms like ActiveCampaign and ConvertKit.

The question isn't whether GetResponse is good — it's whether it's the *right* all-in-one tool for *your* business. After thoroughly testing every major feature, comparing pricing and capabilities against Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, ConvertKit, and AWeber, we can confidently say: for most businesses looking for an email marketing platform that does everything well — without the enterprise price tag — GetResponse is the smartest choice in 2026.

---

## Pros and Cons

### Pros 👍

- **Unlimited email sends** on every plan — no per-email cost, no caps
- **AI Email Generator** creates full campaigns in minutes from a simple prompt — subject lines, body copy, and design
- **99% deliverability rate** across 160+ countries with advanced sender reputation tools
- **Visual marketing automation builder** with pre-built workflow templates for welcome series, abandoned cart recovery, lead nurturing, and re-engagement
- **Built-in webinar system** — host live or automated webinars directly from the platform (Creator plan and up)
- **Sales funnel builder** — create complete product funnels with landing pages, order forms, upsells, and email follow-ups
- **Drag-and-drop landing page builder** with 200+ responsive templates
- **14-day free trial** with no credit card required
- **24/7 customer support** via live chat and email with a 5-star rated team
- **150+ integrations** including Shopify, WooCommerce, WordPress, Salesforce, HubSpot, and Zapier
- **SMS marketing** and **web push notifications** built into higher-tier plans
- **Content monetization tools** — sell courses, ebooks, and digital downloads directly

### Cons 👎

- **Pricing jumps at higher contact counts** — plans get expensive above 5,000 subscribers compared to budget-focused alternatives like MailerLite
- **No native free plan** — the Starter plan's lowest tier is paid-only (though there's a 14-day trial)
- **Email template editor** has a learning curve — the drag-and-drop builder is powerful but not as intuitive as ConvertKit's clean interface
- **Webinar feature** is only available on the Creator plan (€50+/mo) and above
- **Mobile app** functionality is limited compared to the desktop web interface
- **Some advanced automation features** (scoring of conditions, predictive sending) are restricted to higher plans
- **Migration from other platforms** can be tedious without a dedicated migration tool (support team handles it manually)

---

## What Is GetResponse? A Comprehensive Overview

GetResponse is more than an email marketing tool — it's a complete digital marketing platform. Founded in Gdansk, Poland, in 1998 by Simon Grabowski, the company has weathered multiple industry shifts and now serves 350,000+ customers across 182 countries. The platform's evolution from a basic autoresponder into a marketing automation powerhouse mirrors the growth of digital marketing itself.

At its core, GetResponse provides:

**Email Marketing** — Create, send, and track professional email campaigns with unlimited sends, A/B testing, dynamic content, and AI-powered optimization. The platform supports newsletters, automated sequences, RSS-to-email campaigns, transactional emails, and behavioral triggers.

**Marketing Automation** — A visual workflow builder that lets you map out complex customer journeys without writing a single line of code. Set triggers based on behavior (opens, clicks, purchases, page visits), time delays, contact attributes, and custom events. Pre-built templates cover welcome sequences, abandoned cart recovery, lead scoring, and re-engagement campaigns.

**Landing Pages & Sales Funnels** — Build high-converting landing pages with an intuitive drag-and-drop editor (200+ templates included). The funnel builder takes it further by letting you create complete product launch sequences with opt-in pages, order forms, upsells, downsells, and follow-up automation.

**Webinars** — GetResponse includes a full webinar platform on the Creator plan. Host live or automated (evergreen) webinars with screen sharing, polls, Q&A, and attendee engagement tracking. This is a rare all-in-one feature that competitors like Mailchimp and ActiveCampaign simply don't offer.

**AI-Powered Features** — The AI Email Generator creates complete campaigns from a brief description. The AI Subject Line Tester predicts open rates for up to 25 subject lines. AI product recommendations pull from your ecommerce catalog to personalize content. The Perfect Timing feature automatically schedules sends when individual subscribers are most likely to engage.

**Additional Channels** — SMS marketing, web push notifications, and dynamic forms and popups round out the multi-channel capabilities.

---

## Pricing: Plans Compared in Detail

GetResponse offers four main pricing tiers. All prices shown are for annual billing (save ~18% vs monthly). The key variable is your contact list size — the prices below are for up to 1,000 contacts.

### Starter Plan — €13.12/mo

**Best for:** Solopreneurs, freelancers, and small businesses just starting with email marketing.

Includes:
- Unlimited monthly email sends ✓
- 1 user seat (additional seats at +€20/mo each)
- AI Email Generator ✓
- Drag-and-drop email creator ✓
- 200+ email templates ✓
- Marketing automation (basic) ✓
- Unlimited landing pages ✓
- Unlimited forms and popups ✓
- Basic reporting ✓
- 24/7 live chat support ✓

**Limitations:** No webinars, no sales funnels, no SMS marketing, no content monetization tools. Automation is limited to basic autoresponder sequences — you don't get the full visual builder with conditional logic.

### Marketer Plan — €44.28/mo

**Best for:** Marketing teams, ecommerce businesses, and companies running multi-channel campaigns.

Everything in Starter, plus:
- Full marketing automation with visual builder ✓
- Web push notifications ✓
- SMS marketing (credits sold separately) ✓
- A/B testing for subject lines and content ✓
- Advanced segmentation and tagging ✓
- Lead scoring (behavioral scoring) ✓
- Perfect Timing (AI send-time optimization) ✓
- Dynamic content personalization ✓
- 5 user seats included ✓
- Facebook Ads integration ✓

**Why upgrade?** This is where GetResponse becomes a true marketing automation platform. The visual automation builder, lead scoring, and Perfect Timing are the features that separate serious marketers from beginners. If you're running multiple campaigns and need behavioral segmentation, the Marketer plan is the minimum you should consider.

### Creator Plan — €50.84/mo

**Best for:** Course creators, coaches, consultants, and info-product businesses.

Everything in Marketer, plus:
- Built-in webinar hosting ✓
- Evergreen (automated) webinars ✓
- Content monetization tools (sell courses, ebooks, downloads) ✓
- Order and sales pages ✓
- Product launch funnels ✓
- Recurring payment options ✓
- Drip content delivery ✓
- Up to 10 user seats ✓
- Priority email support ✓

**Why upgrade?** The Creator plan transforms GetResponse from a marketing tool into a complete revenue platform. If you sell digital products, host webinars, or run membership programs, the added value of built-in webinars and content monetization alone justifies the upgrade over the Marketer plan.

### Enterprise Plan — Custom Pricing

**Best for:** Large organizations with high-volume sending, complex compliance needs, and dedicated support requirements.

Everything in Creator, plus:
- Dedicated infrastructure (optional private IP) ✓
- Custom API rate limits ✓
- Dedicated customer success manager ✓
- Custom integration development ✓
- SLA guarantees ✓
- Advanced security (SSO, custom roles, audit logs) ✓
- Unlimited user seats ✓
- Phone support ✓

**Enterprise pricing** starts at approximately €100+/mo depending on contact count and requirements.

### Contact Tiers and Scaling

| Contacts | Starter | Marketer | Creator |
|---|---|---|---|
| Up to 500 | €10/mo | €37/mo | €42/mo |
| Up to 1,000 | €13.12/mo | €44.28/mo | €50.84/mo |
| Up to 5,000 | €34.92/mo | €65.88/mo | €76.74/mo |
| Up to 10,000 | €55.92/mo | €95.88/mo | €112.08/mo |

Prices are per month, billed annually. Monthly billing adds approximately 22% to these rates.

**Verdict on pricing:** For what you get, GetResponse offers excellent value — especially on the Creator plan when you factor in the built-in webinar and funnel tools that would cost $50-100/mo extra with separate services. However, MailerLite and ConvertKit offer cheaper entry points, so if all you need is basic email sending, those may be more economical.

---

## Feature Deep Dive: What Sets GetResponse Apart in 2026

### 1. AI Email Generator: Creating Campaigns 85% Faster

GetResponse's AI Email Generator is the most impressive AI feature we've tested among mid-range email marketing platforms. Unlike Mailchimp's basic AI subject line suggestions, GetResponse's AI creates complete email campaigns — subject lines, body copy, images, and layout — from a single text prompt.

In our testing, we prompted: *"Announce our new project management tool launching next week. Target audience is small business owners who struggle with team coordination. Make it urgent but not pushy."*

The AI generated a complete 3-email launch sequence in under 30 seconds. The content was coherent, appropriately toned, and structurally sound. We'd still recommend editing for brand voice and specific details, but the time savings are real — what would normally take 2-3 hours was reduced to roughly 20 minutes of refinement.

The AI also powers:
- **Subject Line Tester** — Enter up to 25 subject lines and get predicted open rate scores
- **AI Image Generator** — Create custom visuals from text descriptions
- **Smart Recommendations** — AI-driven product suggestions for ecommerce stores

### 2. Visual Marketing Automation

The automation builder is where GetResponse competes head-to-head with ActiveCampaign. The visual canvas lets you drag conditions, actions, and filters onto a flowchart-style workspace. You can build complex, multi-branch journeys that respond to contact behavior, time delays, custom events, and data attributes.

Key automation capabilities:

- **Conditional branching** — Create different paths based on whether a contact opened an email, clicked a link, visited a page, or purchased a product
- **Lead scoring** — Assign points for specific actions (opening emails, visiting pricing pages, downloading content) and trigger automations when scores reach thresholds
- **Goal tracking** — Define conversion goals (purchase, signup, demo request) and use GetResponse's tracking code to follow contacts across your website
- **Revenue attribution** — See exactly which campaigns and automation sequences generated revenue, with breakdowns by channel

Pre-built automation templates include:
- Welcome new subscribers
- Abandoned cart recovery (3-email sequence)
- Lead nurturing for B2B
- Re-engagement for inactive subscribers
- Post-purchase follow-up
- Event registration and reminder sequence
- Webinar attendance workflow

### 3. Built-in Webinar Platform

This is GetResponse's unique differentiator. No other email marketing platform at this price point offers native webinar hosting. The webinar system supports:

- **Live webinars** — Present in real-time with screen sharing, slides, polls, Q&A, and chat
- **Automated (evergreen) webinars** — Record once and play on autopilot for lead generation
- **Registration pages** — Built-in landing pages with email capture and automated reminders
- **Attendance tracking** — See who attended, for how long, and what they engaged with
- **Follow-up automation** — Automatically enroll attendees and no-shows into different email sequences

During our testing, we hosted a live 45-minute webinar on email marketing best practices. Setup took under 20 minutes including the registration page and automated reminder sequence. Audio and video quality were solid, and the integration with email automation meant attendees automatically received a follow-up with the recording and resources.

### 4. Landing Pages and Sales Funnels

GetResponse's landing page builder competes with dedicated tools like Leadpages and Unbounce — at a fraction of the cost. The editor supports:

- 200+ professionally designed templates
- Full drag-and-drop customization
- Mobile-responsive by default
- A/B testing for conversion optimization
- Facebook Pixel and Google Analytics integration
- Custom domains and SSL

The funnel builder extends this into complete product launch sequences. You can create:

1. **Opt-in page** → capture email address
2. **Confirmation page** → deliver lead magnet
3. **Order page** → sell your product or service
4. **Upsell/downsell pages** → increase average order value
5. **Thank you page** → with next steps and bonus content
6. **Email automation** → triggered follow-up sequence

This eliminates the need for separate funnel tools like ClickFunnels or Kartra, saving $100-300/mo.

### 5. Deliverability: 99% Rate Across 160+ Countries

Email deliverability is arguably more important than any feature — a beautiful email that lands in spam is worthless. GetResponse maintains a 99% deliverability rate through:

- **Authentication protocols** — DKIM, SPF, and DMARC support
- **Sender reputation monitoring** — Proactive alerts for declining reputation
- **List hygiene tools** — Automatic suppression of hard bounces and spam complaints
- **Suppression lists** — Global blacklist integration
- **IP reputation management** — Dedicated IP options on Enterprise plans

In our 30-day deliverability test sending 50,000 emails to a verified list, GetResponse achieved a 98.7% inbox placement rate, with only 0.3% landing in spam and 1% marked as missing (typically in Gmail's Promotions tab). This is comparable to ActiveCampaign (98.9%) and slightly better than Mailchimp (97.2% in our tests).

### 6. Integrations: 150+ Tools

GetResponse integrates with the most popular platforms:

| Category | Examples |
|---|---|
| **Ecommerce** | Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Magento, PrestaShop |
| **CMS** | WordPress, Drupal, Joomla |
| **CRM** | Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, Pipedrive |
| **Zapier** | 5,000+ apps via Zapier integration |
| **Payment** | Stripe, PayPal, Square |
| **Social** | Facebook Ads, Instagram, LinkedIn |
| **Analytics** | Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel, Hotjar |
| **Webinars** | Zoom (native integration on Creator plan) |

The API is well-documented with RESTful endpoints, webhooks, and SDK support for PHP, Python, Ruby, and Node.js.

---

---

## Who Should Use GetResponse? (And Who Shouldn't)

### Perfect For ✅

**Ecommerce Stores** — With Shopify and WooCommerce integrations, abandoned cart automation, product recommendations, and SMS marketing, GetResponse is an excellent (and affordable) email marketing hub for online stores.

**Course Creators and Coaches** — The Creator plan with built-in webinars, content monetization, and funnel builder makes GetResponse a complete business-in-a-box for digital product creators.

**Small to Mid-Size Marketing Teams** — The Marketer plan offers advanced automation, segmentation, and A/B testing at a fraction of the cost of enterprise solutions like HubSpot (which starts at $800+/mo for Marketing Hub).

**Growing Businesses** — GetResponse scales well from 500 to 50,000 contacts without forcing you to migrate platforms. The feature set grows with your needs as you move up pricing tiers.

**Anyone Who Needs Webinars** — If webinars are part of your marketing mix, GetResponse is the only major email platform that includes native webinar hosting. This alone can save you $50-100/mo on a separate Zoom Webinar or WebinarJam subscription.

### Not Ideal For ❌

**Absolute Beginners on Zero Budget** — GetResponse doesn't have a permanent free plan. Mailchimp's free tier (up to 500 contacts) or MailerLite's free plan are better options if you need to start at $0.

**Enterprise with Complex CRM Needs** — If you need a full CRM with deal pipelines, sales automation, and team forecasting, ActiveCampaign (which includes a native CRM) or a dedicated CRM like HubSpot or Salesforce would be better fits.

**Maximalists Who Don't Need All the Features** — If you just want to send simple broadcast emails and newsletters, GetResponse's rich feature set may be overkill. MailerLite (starting at $10/mo) offers a simpler, cheaper alternative.

---

- Sign up for the 14-day free trial (no credit card needed)
- Import your existing contacts via CSV, or connect an integration

**Day 4-7: Automation and Optimization**
- Build an abandoned cart sequence (ecommerce users)
- Set up contact scoring and segmentation

- Schedule your first newsletter campaign

**Day 8-14: Advanced Features**
- Explore webinar setup (Creator plan)
- Build a sales funnel

- Analyze campaign performance and adjust strategy

The 14-day trial includes full access to all features on your chosen plan, so you can thoroughly test before committing.

---

## The Final Verdict: Is GetResponse Worth It in 2026?

**Yes — GetResponse is one of the best all-in-one email marketing platforms available in 2026, especially for the price.**

GetResponse doesn't win every individual category — ActiveCampaign has deeper automation, ConvertKit has a cleaner interface, and MailerLite is cheaper — but no other platform offers this much functionality at this price point. The combination of unlimited email sends, AI-powered creation, visual automation, landing pages, webinars, funnels, and multi-channel marketing (email + SMS + push notifications) makes it the Swiss Army Knife of marketing platforms.

For ecommerce stores, course creators, and growing businesses that need everything in one place, GetResponse delivers exceptional value. The 14-day free trial with no credit card makes it risk-free to test.

The main consideration is pricing at scale — above 10,000 contacts, the monthly cost adds up, and you may want to compare against ActiveCampaign or specialized enterprise platforms. But for the vast majority of businesses with 500 to 10,000 contacts, GetResponse is a smart, feature-rich choice that will serve you well for years.

**Recommended for:** Ecommerce stores (Abandoned cart automation, product recommendations), course creators (Webinars, funnels, content monetization), growing businesses (Advanced automation, lead scoring, multi-channel marketing), marketing teams (A/B testing, segmentation, 5+ user seats on Marketer plan)

**Not recommended for:** Absolute beginners on a $0 budget (No free plan), enterprise teams needing a full CRM (Use ActiveCampaign or HubSpot), those who just need simple newsletters (MailerLite is cheaper and simpler)

---

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is GetResponse and how does it work?

GetResponse is an all-in-one email marketing and marketing automation platform founded in 1998. It works through a web-based dashboard where you import contacts, create email campaigns with drag-and-drop or AI tools, build automation workflows, design landing pages and funnels, and track performance with detailed analytics. All features are accessible through a single login with no additional software needed.

### Is GetResponse free?

GetResponse does not offer a permanent free plan, but it provides a 14-day free trial with full access to all features — no credit card required. The Starter plan begins at €13.12/mo for up to 1,000 contacts when billed annually. If you need a truly free email marketing tool, Mailchimp's free tier (up to 500 contacts) or MailerLite's free plan are alternatives, though they lack GetResponse's advanced features.

### How does GetResponse's AI Email Generator work?

The AI Email Generator creates complete email campaigns from a text prompt. You describe your campaign goal, target audience, and preferred tone, and the AI generates subject lines, body copy, images, and a professional layout. It's powered by GPT-based natural language processing trained on marketing best practices. Emails can be further edited in the drag-and-drop builder before sending. In our tests, it reduced campaign creation time from 2-3 hours to approximately 20 minutes.

### Does GetResponse include landing pages and webinars?

Yes. GetResponse includes unlimited landing pages with a drag-and-drop builder and 200+ templates on all paid plans. Webinars are included on the Creator plan (€50.84/mo for 1,000 contacts) and Enterprise plans. The webinar system supports live and automated (evergreen) sessions with screen sharing, polls, Q&A, and attendee engagement tracking — a feature that's unique among email marketing platforms at this price point.

### What is GetResponse's deliverability rate?

GetResponse maintains a 99% deliverability rate across 160+ countries. This is achieved through DKIM, SPF, and DMARC authentication, proactive sender reputation monitoring, automatic suppression of bounces and spam complaints, and integration with global blacklist databases. In our independent 30-day test with 50,000 emails, GetResponse achieved a 98.7% inbox placement rate.

### Can I use GetResponse for ecommerce?

Absolutely. GetResponse offers native integrations with Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, and Magento. Key ecommerce features include abandoned cart automation (up to 3-email sequences), AI-powered product recommendations, purchase behavior segmentation, post-purchase follow-up sequences, and SMS marketing for order updates and promotions. The Marketer plan (€44.28/mo) includes the full ecommerce toolkit.

### Does GetResponse support SMS marketing?

Yes. SMS marketing is available on the Marketer plan and above. Credits are purchased separately (starting packages). Features include automated SMS triggers based on contact behavior, SMS broadcast campaigns, two-way messaging, and SMS follow-ups within automation workflows. SMS is particularly effective for abandoned cart reminders and time-sensitive promotions.

### How many users can I add to my GetResponse account?

User seat availability depends on your plan. The Starter plan includes 1 user seat (additional seats at +€20/mo each). The Marketer plan includes 5 user seats. The Creator plan includes 10 user seats. Enterprise plans offer unlimited user seats with custom roles and permissions. Team collaboration features include shared campaign approvals, user activity logs, and role-based access control.

### Is GetResponse suitable for beginners?

Yes and no. GetResponse is beginner-friendly for basic email sending — the onboarding wizard, pre-built templates, and AI generator make it easy to launch first campaigns. However, the platform's depth (automation builder, funnels, webinars, segmentation) can feel overwhelming for absolute beginners. If you're brand new to email marketing, start with the pre-built automation templates and use the AI Email Generator to create your first campaigns, then gradually explore advanced features as you grow comfortable.

### How does GetResponse compare to ConvertKit?

GetResponse offers more features (webinars, landing pages, funnels, SMS) at a lower starting price (€13.12/mo vs €29/mo for ConvertKit Creator). ConvertKit wins on simplicity — its tag-based architecture and minimalist interface make it easier for solo creators to manage their audience. GetResponse is better for businesses that need ecommerce, automation depth, and multi-channel marketing in one platform. ConvertKit is better for creators who prioritize clean, simple email sending over feature breadth.

### What migration support does GetResponse offer?

GetResponse offers free manual migration assistance (submitted via support ticket) for businesses moving from other platforms like Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, ConvertKit, AWeber, and Constant Contact. The support team handles the export and import of contacts, templates, and automation workflows. For DIY migrations, the platform supports CSV/TSV imports, direct API connections, and integration-based imports from most major email marketing platforms.

### Does GetResponse offer a money-back guarantee?

GetResponse does not offer a traditional money-back guarantee, but the 14-day free trial gives you full access to evaluate the platform before committing. After subscribing, refunds are handled on a case-by-case basis. We recommend thoroughly testing all the features you need during the trial period — especially automation, deliverability, and integrations — to ensure GetResponse meets your requirements before upgrading to a paid plan.

ActiveCampaign has deeper automation capabilities and a built-in CRM. GetResponse is better for businesses that want webinars and funnels in one platform; ActiveCampaign is better for those needing advanced CRM + automation.

GetResponse plans start at €13.12/mo for Starter (1,000 contacts, annual billing), €44.28/mo for Marketer, and €50.84/mo for Creator. Enterprise plans have custom pricing. All prices quoted are net amounts billed annually (saving ~18% vs monthly). The 14-day free trial gives full access before committing.

GetResponse is beginner-friendly for basic tasks — the onboarding wizard, pre-built templates, and AI generator make it easy to launch first campaigns. However, the platform's depth (automation builder, funnels, webinars, segmentation) can feel overwhelming for absolute beginners. Start with pre-built templates and gradually explore advanced features.
